title: Optimal assignments in a markovian queueing system

tldr.text: A generalization of the Hypercube queueing model for exponential queueing systems is presented which allows for distinguishable servers and multiple types of customers and combines the method of successive approximations and “Howard's method” in a manner which is particularly applicable to Markov decision problems having large, sparse transition matrices.
